mapper.insert: INSERT INTO digital_team_prompt_template (business_id, prompt_key, agent_scope, scene, version, status, template_content, variables_schema, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{promptKey}, #{agentScope}, #{scene}, #{version}, 'DRAFT', #{templateContent}, #{variablesSchema}, #{createdBy})
